description: Schema definition for Customer entity that stores comprehensive customer information

id.desc: Unique identifier for the customer record

company.desc: The company name associated with the customer; references the Companies schema's name field

displayName.desc: The display name used for the customer

type.desc: Category or type of the customer

addressLine1.desc: Primary address line for the customer's location

addressLine2.desc: Secondary address line for the customer's location (optional)

city.desc: City where the customer is located

state.desc: State or region of the customer's address

postalCode.desc: Postal or ZIP code of the customer's address

phoneNumber.desc: Contact phone number for the customer

email.desc: Contact email address for the customer

website.desc: URL of the customer's website (if available)

taxLiable.desc: Indicates whether the customer is tax liable

taxAreaId.desc: Identifier for the customer's applicable tax area

taxAreaDisplayName.desc: Display name for the customer's tax area

taxRegistrationNumber.desc: Tax registration number associated with the customer

currencyId.desc: Identifier for the currency used by the customer

currencyCode.desc: Currency code (e.g., USD, EUR) associated with the customer

paymentTermsId.desc: Identifier for the payment terms agreed upon by the customer

shipmentMethodId.desc: Identifier for the customer's preferred shipment method

paymentMethodId.desc: Identifier for the default payment method for the customer

blocked.desc: Status flag indicating if the customer is blocked or inactive

lastModifiedDateTime.desc: Timestamp of the last update made to the customer's record
